title: AnophelesModel Documentation
text: AnophelesModel package parameterises model mosquito feeding cycle (Chitnis, Smith, Steketee 2008) using mosquito bionomics, human activity patterns, user-supplied intervention efficacy parameters. estimates species-specific impact vector control interventions vectorial capacity can generate parameterisations OpenMalaria. Version 2 refactoring version 1 backward compatible (see NEWS.md differences). five feeding-cycle stages : Host seeking → Host found (PAi) → Fed (PBi) → Resting (PCi) → Ovipositing (PDi) → back Host seeking (PEi). typical analysis follows steps: def_vector_params(), def_host_params() def_activity_patterns() (calculate_exposure()) build_model_obj() build_intervention() (get_ITN_params() published ITN parameterisations) calculate_impact(), run_interventions() many scenarios uncertainty draws optionally, export OpenMalaria

title: Fill the vector control placeholders of a scenario table — om_scenario_values
text: Adds user's OpenMalaria scenario table (one row per scenario, built user wants, e.g. expand.grid()) values placeholders vector control intervention, row row: efficacies (<name>_deterrency, ...),     intervention list several nets: net named     column net; decay parameters (<name>_deterrency_L years,     <name>_deterrency_k, ...), intervention defined     decay = "placeholder"; dummy-host availabilities (<name>_dummy_<k>_pop<j>)     dummy-host nets, net coverages vary: coverage     campaign \(k\) \(\times\) KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute /     human availability population \(j\), coverages taken     columns named like coverage placeholders schedule (e.g.     cov2021); decay dummy hosts host-seeking     killing (<name>_hsk_L, <name>_hsk_k), filled     decays. placeholders written define_OM_vector_control / deploy_OM_vector_control (get_OM_xml) filled: intervention's record (nets, placeholders, populations, schedule) read source. columns row order kept; coverages scenario design stay user's. Decays. decays differ effects insecticide decay effect (net's parameterisation), attrition common effects. combine = TRUE (default), halflife kappa name one attrition column (e.g. usage-adjusted attrition): effect's decay attrition combined effect's insecticide decay (fitted Weibull needed, fit_years om_vector_control), host-seeking killing (dummy hosts) included. combine = FALSE, columns final decays, written : one column per effect (named vector, e.g. c(Deterrency = "hl_det", PrePrandial = "hl_pre", PostPrandial = "hl_post", KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute = "hl_hsk")) one column effects (host-seeking killing: decay dummy hosts). Without columns, net's decay used. Decay columns need intervention defined decay = "placeholder". Half-life shape replaced independently: kappa column alone changes shape keeps half-life (way round), rest coming net (attrition combine = TRUE; exported decay effect combine = FALSE). Values must positive numbers (shape decay function one); errors name rows effect. Values computed per distinct net decay, large tables fast.

what: Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets — run_interventions
title: Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets — run_interventions
text: Fully vectorised runner: evaluates entomological model every combination intervention parameter set, coverage value, (optionally) vector parameter draw. param_sets × coverage combinations evaluated single matrix call eval_entomological_model() per timepoint per draw, avoiding per-row R loop overhead scaling efficiently tens thousands parameter sets. Two model structures supported mutually exclusive. model auto-detected param_sets: Standard (3-host):     killing_during_host_seeking_absolute column (values     NA). Uses deterrency, preprandial,     postprandial. Dummy-host (4-host):     killing_during_host_seeking_absolute column present     least one non-NA value. Uses deterrency,     killing_during_host_seeking_absolute, postprandial.     preprandial must 0 rows.

title: Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets — run_interventions
code: run_interventions(   param_sets,   model_p,   coverage_vec,   vec_param_sets = NULL,   interv_param_sets = NULL,   exposure_sets = NULL,   coverage_sets = NULL,   duration_years = 3,   insecticide_decay = TRUE,   exposure = 1,   keep_time = FALSE )

title: Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets — run_interventions
text: param_sets Data frame row defines one parameter set. Required columns: deterrency: initial deterrency efficacy [0,1] preprandial: initial pre-prandial killing efficacy     [0,1] (set 0 dummy-host model) postprandial: initial post-prandial killing efficacy     [0,1] halflife_attrition: attrition decay parameter L     (days): half-life Weibull / exponential / Hill, time zero     linear / step / smooth-compact (column can omitted every     row decay_attrition = "none") shape_attrition: attrition decay shape parameter (required     Weibull / Hill / smooth-compact; NA omitted otherwise) decay_attrition: decay shape string (see     decay_function()) Optional columns: name: label parameter set (used     plot_impact()); column also carried output. killing_during_host_seeking_absolute: activates     dummy-host (4-host) model; absolute availability dummy host (see     KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute build_intervention()).     Non-missing values must finite non-negative; NA means     inactive. halflife_det, halflife_pre, halflife_post,     halflife_hsk: per-component linear insecticide decay (years);     despite name, time effect reaches zero (see     halflife_insecticide build_intervention()).     halflife_hsk applies     killing_during_host_seeking_absolute dummy-host mode. decay_det, L_det, kappa_det (equivalently     _pre, _post, _hsk): general per-component decay     function, L (days; meaning depends shape, see     decay_function()), shape. _hsk controls decay     killing_during_host_seeking_absolute. Overrides corresponding     halflife_* column whenever shape specified. Constant shapes     need L_* kappa_*; shapes require     parameters (incomplete specifications raise error). model_p Model object build_model_obj(). coverage_vec Non-empty numeric vector finite deployment coverages [0,1]. Coverage 0 used internally -intervention baseline computing avg_impact; added automatically present, corresponding row included output explicitly supplied. vec_param_sets Optional data frame vector parameter draws (columns vec_ent_param). row one draw. Adds draw column output. interv_param_sets Optional data frame n_draw rows columns param_sets. Row d replaces param_sets draw d. list n_draw single-row data frames also accepted backward compatibility. exposure_sets Optional numeric vector (list) n_draw exposure factors; replaces exposure draw, e.g. propagate uncertainty activity patterns via calculate_exposure(). coverage_sets Optional list n_draw coverage vectors; replaces coverage_vec draw. duration_years Single finite positive duration years (one time point per day, least one point). Default 3 years. insecticide_decay Logical (default TRUE). FALSE, per-component insecticide decay columns (halflife_*, decay_*, L_*, kappa_*) ignored: efficacies keep initial (e.g. unwashed) values attrition decays. exposure Proportion human exposure bites occurs intervention protects, [0, 1] (default 1). intervention acts effective coverage coverage * exposure. Typically calculate_exposure(...)$Exposure_Indoor_whileinbed ITNs, $indoor_resting $Exposure_Indoor_total IRS (see calculate_exposure). keep_time Logical (default FALSE): also return vectorial capacity impact day (memory-heavy large sweeps).

Dummy-host model: host-seeking killing (KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute) adds fourth host type whose availability absolute killing rate (units host availabilities, probability). mutually exclusive pre-prandial killing. get_ITN_params(mode = "dummy_host") converts hut-trial estimates, relative control-arm availability alpha_0, absolute values multiplying alpha_0 arm (rescale_hsk = FALSE returns relative value). hut model’s rates per hut-night package uses per-day rates; provisional convention hut-night treated day (conversion host-seeking duration td), pending improved experimental hut fitting model.
